artifact.self_contained_problem:
Define the Almkvist–Zudilin numbers by
$$A_n=\sum_{k=0}^{n}(-1)^{n-k}\frac{(3k)!}{(k!)^3}\binom{n}{k}\binom{n+k}{k},\qquad n=0,1,2,\dots,$$
and, more generally, set $A_n(x)=\sum_{k=0}^{n}(-1)^{n-k}\binom{n}{k}\binom{n+k}{k}\frac{(3k)!}{(k!)^3}x^k$ (so that $A_n=A_n(1)$). Let $\left(\frac{\cdot}{p}\right)$ denote the Legendre symbol. Decide whether the following three statements are all true.

(i) For every odd prime $p$,
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}A_k\equiv\begin{cases}4x^2-2p\pmod{p^2} & \text{if }p\equiv 1,3\pmod 8\text{ and }p=x^2+2y^2\text{ with }x,y\in\mathbb{Z},\\ 0\pmod{p^2} & \text{if }p\equiv 5,7\pmod 8,\end{cases}$$
and
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}(-1)^k A_k\equiv\begin{cases}4x^2-2p\pmod{p^2} & \text{if }p\equiv 1\pmod 3\text{ and }p=x^2+3y^2\text{ with }x,y\in\mathbb{Z},\\ 0\pmod{p^2} & \text{if }p\equiv 2\pmod 3.\end{cases}$$

(ii) For every prime $p>3$:
- if $p\equiv 1\pmod 3$, then $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}(-1)^k A_k\equiv \sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}^3}{16^k}\pmod{p^3}$;
- if $p\equiv 1,3\pmod 8$, then $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}A_k\equiv \sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{4k}{k,k,k,k}}{256^k}\pmod{p^3}$.

(iii) For every prime $p>3$ and every
$$x\in\{1,-4,9,-48,81,-324,2401,9801,-25920,-777924,96059601\}\cup\bigl\{\tfrac{81}{256},-\tfrac{9}{16},\tfrac{81}{32},-3969\bigr\}$$
with $x\not\equiv 0\pmod p$ (interpreting denominators as inverses mod $p$),
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}A_k(x)\equiv\left(\frac{x}{p}\right)\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{4k}{k,k,k,k}}{(256x)^k}\pmod{p^2}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: A web search shows substantial subsequent work proving various supercongruences for Almkvist–Zudilin numbers conjectured by Z.-W. and Z.-H. Sun (e.g., results on related b_n sequences and on congruences via the WZ method or q-microscope), but no single source clearly confirms that all three parts (i)–(iii) of this particular conjecture, including the mod $p^3$ relations and the full list of special values in part (iii), have been established. The status is therefore inconclusive from the search.

status_evidence.title: Proof of a recent conjecture of Z.-W. Sun
status_evidence.snippet: Proves a supercongruence conjectured by Z.-W. Sun.
status_evidence.claim: Some Sun-type Almkvist–Zudilin supercongruences have been proved, but this entry is not specifically Conjecture A64.

status_evidence.title: Proof of Some Conjectural Congruences Involving Almkvist–Zudilin Numbers b_n
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes congruences modulo p^4 for Almkvist–Zudilin-type numbers b_n.
status_evidence.claim: Related Almkvist–Zudilin congruences have been proven, indicating active progress but not a definitive resolution of all parts of the stated conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Supercongruence conjectured by Z.-W. Sun and the WZ method
status_evidence.snippet: Uses the WZ method to confirm a supercongruence conjectured by Z.-W. Sun.
status_evidence.claim: Demonstrates ongoing proof activity on Sun's conjectures without confirming this specific multi-part conjecture in full.
